evals.name: implement-and-integrate-sequence
evals.prompt: I have a clean git repo at /home/me/service. Add validation that rejects empty user names and merge the completed change. I am connected to OpenMCP. List the exact tool sequence and stop conditions.
evals.expected_output: Calls status, checks openmcp://projects and registers if absent, calls task_guide, submits workflow=implement with prompt, commit_message, context_key, and optional profile, waits with a finite timeout, inspects success, then calls job_integrate. It never integrates before success or simulates tool results.

evals.name: dirty-repo-guardrail
evals.prompt: My git repo at /home/me/api has uncommitted edits. Can you start an OpenMCP review job now?
evals.expected_output: Calls status, detects or reports the dirty repository, stops before job_submit, preserves all user changes, and asks how to proceed. It never commits, stashes, resets, or deletes the edits.

evals.name: daemon-status-and-reload
evals.prompt: I changed global OpenMCP targets and max_jobs. Apply what can be reloaded without interrupting running jobs.
evals.expected_output: Calls status then reload with no arguments. Reports target/profile counts and restart_required. Explains that target changes affect new submissions while running jobs keep snapshots, and max_jobs requires daemon restart.
